_notice: Concept redesign preview (a proposal). Not the official Hu's Noodle Nook website; facts and prices may be out of date. Official site: https://husnoodlenook.ca
name: hus-noodle-nook
description: Read-only facts and menu search for Hu's Noodle Nook, a ramen and noodle restaurant in Edmonton, AB. All answers derive from https://husnoodlenook.ca/data/restaurant.json.

policies.ordering: Agents must not place orders or payments; hand the user the start_order link.
policies.allergens: Allergen and diet tags are inferred from menu descriptions. Always advise users to confirm allergies with staff.

transports.description: Tools are registered in-page via navigator.modelContext on every page that loads /assets/webmcp.js.
Equivalent static data for agents without tool support.

tools.name: get_hours
tools.description: Weekly opening hours in America/Edmonton time, plus a note about holidays.

tools.name: is_open_now
tools.description: Whether the restaurant is open right now (America/Edmonton), with today's hours and the next opening time.

tools.name: get_menu
tools.description: Full menu, or one category, with prices in CAD.

tools.name: search_menu
tools.description: Filter dishes by diet, spice level, excluded allergens, protein, max price or free-text query.

spicy.description: true = only spicy or mildly spicy; false = only non-spicy.

tools.name: get_location_and_parking
tools.description: Address, building, neighbourhood, map link, parking instructions, accessibility and contact.

tools.name: start_order
tools.description: Returns the official online ordering link (pickup) and delivery partners. Does not place an order.
